name: link-button
title: Link Button
description: A text-style button component with underline decoration, multiple variants, and polymorphic icon support. Uses namespace exports: LinkButton.Root, LinkButton.Icon.

docs.lead: A text-style button component with underline decoration, multiple variants, and polymorphic icon support.
docs.usage:
import * as LinkButton from "@/components/ui/link-button"

<LinkButton.Root variant="gray">
  Link Button
</LinkButton.Root>

examples.title: Gray
examples.description: The gray variant with subdued text color.

examples.title: Black
examples.description: The black variant with strong text color.

examples.title: Primary
examples.description: The primary variant using the brand color.

examples.title: Error
examples.description: The error variant for destructive link actions.

examples.title: Modifiable
examples.description: The modifiable variant provides no default styling, allowing full customization via className.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Link buttons come in medium (default) and small sizes.

examples.title: Underline
examples.description: Use the underline prop to show permanent underline decoration.
examples.code:
<LinkButton.Root underline variant="gray">Link Button</LinkButton.Root>
<LinkButton.Root underline variant="primary">Link Button</LinkButton.Root>

examples.title: With Icon
examples.description: Use LinkButton.Icon with the `as` prop for polymorphic icon rendering.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.code:
<LinkButton.Root variant="gray" disabled>Link Button</LinkButton.Root>
<LinkButton.Root variant="primary" disabled>Link Button</LinkButton.Root>

examples.title: As Child
examples.description: Use the asChild prop with Radix Slot to render as a different element, such as a link.
